sources.title: MMS · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MMS-TTS uses the same model architecture as VITS, which was added to 🤗 Transformers in v4.33. MMS trains a separate model checkpoint for each of the 1100+ languages in the project.

sources.snippet: MMS trains a separate model checkpoint for each of the 1100+ languages in the project. All available checkpoints can be found on the Hugging Face Hub: facebook/mms-tts, and the inference documentation under VITS.
